name: deepx_batch_generate
description: High-performance parallel generation engine: batch generate multiple images or videos (supports 100+ prompts). Accepts an array of prompts OR a raw multi-scene script text with empty lines (gaps) separating scenes. Features rapid back-to-back queueing into Google Flow, parallel execution, pacing delays, automatic retries, custom #tag file naming, auto-download, and continuous storytelling concatenation (is_concat=true) where the ending frame of video N feeds into start frame of video N+1.

auto_download.description: If true, automatically downloads finished files to Chrome Downloads folder.

download_folder.description: Subfolder under Chrome Downloads where media will be saved.

duration.description: Duration for video items in seconds (5, 8, or 10).

is_concat.description: If true, runs scenes sequentially and extracts the ending frame of clip N as the start frame for clip N+1 for seamless video storytelling.

pacing_delay_sec.description: Delay between dispatching prompts into Google Flow (default: 1.5s).

prompts.description: Array of prompts to generate. Include #tags (e.g. 'Hero jumping #scene_01') for automatic orderly file naming.

rapid_dispatch.description: If true (AnyAI style), pastes all prompts into Google Flow back-to-back so all scenes render in parallel on Flow's cluster.

script_text.description: Raw storyboard or commercial script text. Separate each scene prompt with an empty line (gap). DeepX will parse and dispatch each scene automatically.

wait_for_completion.description: If true, waits for all parallel videos to finish rendering. If false, returns immediately once all prompts are queued.
